name: Gladius
description: A male alien arena gladiator in his forties, scarred and huge-hearted, who sings stadium rock and plays every crowd like a packed coliseum.
build: Tall and heavily muscled: broad shoulders, a deep chest, thick arms and legs of human length, a solid waist, standing upright with straight knees. Each hand has four thick digits: a thumb and three fingers.
face: Slate-blue pebbled alien skin, a heavy bony brow ridge, deep-set amber eyes, a broad flat nose, a wide jaw, two short blunt ivory tusks rising from the lower lip, and one bold pale scar running diagonally across the character-left cheek.
hair: A tall stiff crest of rust-orange hair running front to back along the top of the skull, the sides of the head bare slate-blue skin.
outfit: Heavy segmented bronze pauldrons, three wide overlapping plates on each shoulder, strapped over a bare chest by a wide dark-brown leather harness crossing in an X; a wide dark-brown leather belt with a plain round bronze boss and empty loops; a knee-length skirt of wide rust-red leather strips; bronze greaves over the shins and plain dark-brown sandals. Both forearms and both four-fingered hands are bare.
performance_style: Wide and planted: feet shoulder-width apart, weight even. Both arms spread out and down from the sides, the character-right and character-left four-fingered hands open, empty, fingers spread and fully visible. Head level, a broad tusked grin.
location: A sunlit alien arena seen from its sand floor running to the bottom of the frame: curved tiers of stone seating packed with an abstract blur of crowd, tall bronze pillars and a pale orange sky with two moons.
recognition_cues: slate-blue skin with two short ivory tusks
three-plate bronze pauldrons on both shoulders over an X harness
a tall rust-orange crest of hair
palette: pauldrons, belt boss and greaves bronze #B07A34 / #6E4A1C / #DDAA5E
harness, belt and sandals dark-brown leather #4A2E1C / #2A190E / #6E4A30
avoid: a sword, shield, spear or net

sing.intent: Stadium-rock vocal loop: the mic in the character-right hand comes up to the mouth, the character-left fist pumps high above the head twice, then he leans back on a held note and returns to the wide stance. The mouth must visibly open and change shape across the loop so he unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: Brief startle at a crashing gong: the shoulders hunch, the head pulls back and both open hands lift to chest height, then he rolls the shoulders and settles. No opponent or contact.
animations.guard: One-shot stage self-protection: turn a pauldron forward and raise both open forearms before the chest, then hold a planted finish. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: stride in with heavy steps, raise both open hands to the crowd, then plant into the wide open-armed stance.
